Child safety

The workbook contains no advertising and does not require a child account. An adult should manage downloads, future purchases and contact with support. Please do not send children's names, photographs, recordings, learning records or other sensitive information. Learning progress stays on the device. For the website operator and personal-data requests, see our Legal information and Privacy pages.

Cookies and local storage

An internet connection is needed to load the online sample. Any saved progress is stored in this browser on this device; clearing browser data may remove it. The downloadable Windows edition is separate.
